'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 missile explosion in Poland]]
****[[Germany]] says that it will deploy [[MIM-104 Patriot|Patriot]] [[surface-to-air missile]] systems on the [[Poland–Ukraine border]] in order to protect Polish [[airspace]]. Polish Defense Minister [[Mariusz Błaszczak]] says that he has accepted the German proposal. [https://www.ibtimes.com/germany-deploy-patriot-air-defense-system-along-polands-border-ukraine-3639019 (''International Business Times'')]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[2022 Chad attack]]
***Ten [[Chadian military|Chadian soldiers]] are killed and many others injured in an attack by [[Boko Haram]] in [[Lac (region)|Lac Region]], [[Chad]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/boko-haram-fighters-kill-10-chadian-soldiers-near-nigeria-border-2022-11-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[South Thailand insurgency]]
**One person is killed and 30 others injured in a [[car bomb]]ing at a [[Royal Thai Police|police]] compound in [[Narathiwat]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/22/one-killed-30-injured-in-southern-thailand-car-bombing (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**At least 14 people, including eight [[Volunteers for the Defense of the Homeland]] members, are killed in two separate attacks by [[jihadist]]s in northern [[Burkina Faso]], with one occurring near [[Markoye]], [[Oudalan]]. [https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/world/2022/11/23/14-killed-in-two-burkina-faso-attacks-by-jihadist-groups/ (AFP via Free Malaysia Today)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 37 people are killed after two buses collide head-on in [[Maiduguri]], [[Nigeria]], and caught fire, followed by a third bus that crashed into them. [https://www.africanews.com/2022/11/23/at-least-37-dead-in-nigerian-bus-crash// (Africannews)]
*A [[Robinson R44|helicopter]] crashes in [[Charlotte, North Carolina]], [[United States]], killing the pilot and a [[meteorologist]], both [[WBTV]] news station employees. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/22/us/charlotte-north-carolina-helicopter-crash/index.html (CNN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Australia–India relations]]
**[[Australia–India Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement]]
***The [[Parliament of Australia|Australian parliament]] ratifies a [[free trade agreement]] with [[India]]. [https://www.timesnownews.com/business-economy/economy/australian-parliament-passes-free-trade-agreement-with-india-article-95677573 (Times Now News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Chesapeake shooting]]
**Six people are killed and four others injured during a [[mass shooting]] at a [[Walmart Supercenter]] in [[Chesapeake, Virginia]], United States. The perpetrator, identified as the supermarket's store manager, kills himself after the shooting. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/22/us/chesapeake-virginia-walmart-shooting/index.html (CNN)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 FIFA World Cup]]
**The [[Saudi Arabia national football team]] defeats [[Argentina national football team|Argentina]] [[2022 FIFA World Cup Group C|2–1]] in an upset. With this loss, Argentina fails to equal [[Italy national football team|Italy]]'s record 37-match unbeaten streak in [[Association football|international football]]. [https://www.npr.org/2022/11/22/1138566357/messi-argentina-saudi-arabia-world-cup-upset-qatar (NPR)]
